A '''disease''' that induced fever and hallucinations spread on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Dorlass]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], forcing a quarantine to be enforced in order to contain the plague.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|The Terror Plague}}</ref>
